name: write the computed integer as text to the required output file
definition: Emit the final integer in base-10 textual form to a fixed output path, tolerating trailing whitespace/newline.
failure_mode: Wrong serialization or wrong path makes the output check fail.

name: aggregate and rank call-site frequency
definition: Count occurrences of each unique signature, sort by frequency descending, and truncate to the top 10 most common call sites.
failure_mode: Wrong ranking or missing/extra entries mismatch the expected list.

name: build a serial de bruijn graph assembler
definition: construct a k-mer de Bruijn graph in a hash table with separate chaining from k-mer+extension records and traverse it to emit DNA contigs, one per line.
failure_mode: assembler produces malformed/binary-arbitrary contigs fails the DNA-only, nonempty output test

name: define call sites by a fixed-size frame signature
definition: Treat the top three innermost frames as the identity of a call site; a trace with fewer frames still contributes via its available top frames.
failure_mode: Using all frames or a different key coalesces/splits unique sites incorrectly and changes the top-10.
